name: Western: Location Exterior
description: Image preset for a location exterior in the Western look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for an exterior establishing shot. Name the location's defining structure, surroundings, time of day, and weather from the entity, then apply the style.
context_prompt: wide exterior establishing view of the location, clear foreground, midground and background, a sense of scale from a figure or doorway, classic western film still, wide anamorphic frame, weathered faces, dust-caked leather and denim, sun-bleached timber, hard midday sun or golden-hour backlight, ochre and rust palette, long shadows, heat haze
negative_prompt: modern vehicles, power lines, clean clothes, neon, lush green forest, text, watermark
